Premise: holds, measured on `origin/main` `0e882086`: an out-of-range `/sign-in/email` answers `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED` and hands the audit sink nothing (real or unknown email); an MFA-held sign-in is not a refusal on `main` (200, a session and a `login` row; the hold is computed per session read), so its hold rides that `login` row
Serial constraints cleared: PR1 none. PR2 waits on #30922 (claimed by repo:cloud#3, whose claim declares plugin-auth's IP allow-list middleware)

Series of two: PR1 `Refs #30924` — the MFA hold recorded on the held sign-in's own `login` row (`context.reason: 'MFA_REQUIRED'`, `context.rule: 'mfa_required'`), `Clause-②: no`. PR2 `Fixes #30924` — one `login_failed` row per `/sign-in/*` IP refusal (`context.reason: 'IP_NOT_ALLOWED'`, `context.rule: 'ip_allow_list'`, client address, the account where it resolves), bounded per address per 10-minute window (rows at the 1st / 10th / 100th refusal carrying `context.attempts`) plus a global per-window cap; `userId` optional on the exported audit event type → `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on PR2 alone, contract review owed there. No row carries the refused credential.
